annotation.title_clean: 国务院办公厅关于加快场景培育和开放 推动新场景大规模应用的实施意见
annotation.title_en: Implementation Opinions of the General Office of the State Council on Accelerating the Cultivation and Opening of Scenarios and Promoting Large-Scale Application of New Scenarios
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院办公厅 (General Office of the State Council of China)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese State Council General Office opinion (Guobanfa [2025] No. 37) on cultivating and opening application scenarios to drive large-scale deployment of new technologies, including AI, robots, unmanned systems, low-altitude economy, medical and service robots. Emphasises innovation, regulatory pressure-testing, fair allocation of scenarios, and safety risk controls.
key_provisions_or_claims: Build comprehensive, industry-integrated and high-value scenarios across digital economy, AI, unmanned systems, manufacturing, logistics, healthcare and elder care.
Promote full-space (sea, land, air) unmanned systems applications and standards; cautiously expand low-altitude economy.
Use scenarios for regulatory pressure testing and to validate rules and standards, informing laws and regulations.
Ensure fair, non-discriminatory allocation of scenario resources; state-owned enterprises to open scenarios.
Improve safety risk controls for new scenarios and monitor employment impacts; NDRC coordinates implementation.
